title: T15: installed-skill clock and Scoreboard telemetry
head: codex/t15-clock
body:
## What
T15 (decision #30), separate from T12b.
- `anorak.clock`: `DirectorySkillRegistry` reads each installed skill's five-field cron schedule. `LoopSkillScheduler` submits due work through the existing T07 scheduler at scheduled priority, so resources, pause and ask-first gates still apply. `SkillClock` suppresses duplicates and catches up **once** after sleep, not once per missed tick. `tick()` returns a `ClockDispatch` right away, so a long skill does not hold up later dispatches.
- Sync `set_paused(bool)` and `stop()`. T12b's service can call these structurally, with no import between the branches.
- `anorak.telemetry`: append-only task start/end, first-try/fix, ask-first gate events, proposal shown/answered, watcher baselines, cited answers and weekly check-ins. All ten Scoreboard measures now compute from real records; missing source data stays `not_measured`, never made up.
- Event-loop fix: the real-loop test used to create dispatch tasks in one `asyncio.run` and await them in another. It now runs in one loop, and every clock test drains its tasks.

## Open question for Braden
While paused, ticks dispatch nothing and move the watermark forward. Skills due during a pause are **skipped**, not caught up after unpause. Say if you want one catch-up run after unpause instead (like after sleep).

## Checks (rerun by coordinator on this commit)
- `uv run --no-sync pytest -q` → 344 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected (stable across two runs)
- `uv run --no-sync ruff check .` → All checks passed
- `ruff format --check` on changed files → already formatted. Repo-wide, it fails on about 10 files that are already unformatted on `main` (3265e152) and untouched here.
- `uv run --no-sync mypy --strict src` → no issues in 27 files (native and `--platform win32`)
- `git diff --check` → clean

## Notes
- Both this PR and T12b add a `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased entry. Whichever merges second needs a one-line rebase.
